recovery.title: Recover access
recovery.explanation: Confirm your device security in a new system window. After verification, you can choose a new Tokenlogue PIN. Unlocking the screen alone does not replace this check.
recovery.waiting: Complete verification in the device system window.
recovery.cancel_notice: Cancelling keeps your previous PIN, key and conversations.
recovery.choose_instructions: Choose four digits from 0 to 9 and repeat them. Your previous PIN remains valid until the new one is saved. Remember your new PIN or store it somewhere safe.
recovery.verified_notice: Device security was verified. Choose a new PIN to access your saved conversations.
recovery.failed: Device security could not be verified. Your previous PIN and conversations have been kept.
recovery.unavailable: Device recovery is unavailable on this device. Sign in with your previous PIN.
recovery.expired: This confirmation has expired. Start a new device verification.
recovery.cancelled: Recovery was cancelled. Enter your previous PIN.
recovery.replace_key_notice: Replace only the OpenRouter API key. Your app PIN, conversation encryption key, history and drafts are kept. The saved API key stays in place until the new key is checked and saved.
recovery.protection_notice_android: After sign-in, Tokenlogue will protect older local chat titles, messages and drafts before opening conversations. A forgotten app PIN can be recovered through a separate Android device security check.
recovery.protection_notice_other: After sign-in, Tokenlogue will protect older local chat titles, messages and drafts before opening conversations. Device recovery of a forgotten PIN is unavailable on this platform. Keep your PIN safe.
recovery.protection_notice_android_unava: After sign-in, Tokenlogue will protect older local chat titles, messages and drafts before opening conversations. Device recovery of a PIN requires Android 11 or later and compatible device security. Recovery is currently unavailable here. Keep your PIN safe.
